svg.title: TSP fund share price growth, drawdowns, and volatility
svg.text: Five individual funds · Jun 02, 2003 to Nov 23, 2026 · 5,862 published dates
Each fund starts at $100 on the same date. The vertical axis uses a log scale.
Percentage below each fund’s highest share price up to that date.
Return compounds over the full period. Volatility uses daily changes × √252.
Source: TSP Share Price History CSV · Figures calculated from published share prices
